unt_end_of_term.what: University of North Texas End of Term web archive (LOC/IA/CDL/GPO/UNT crawls), id_ replay
unt_end_of_term.robots: generic agents allowed (named AI crawlers are not)

internet_archive_wayback.conclusion: captures ingested (up to the cap, one per distinct digest)

library_of_congress_scans.why: LOC holds U.S. Code editions and supplements 1934-1988, with executive-order tables (1940-1958 included/repealed/eliminated lists; Table IV or VI 1964-1988). The scans come from HeinOnline, whose item notices say Hein has not made them available for commercial purposes, including bulk download. The owner has not decided. This job makes no request to loc.gov. A smoke test of at most 3 items, slowly, is allowed; its text layer has scrambled columns and would need column-aware parsing or OCR.
